scope: Read-only integrated review of the working-tree first-creation audio vertical; no repository writes or full-suite rerun.

reviewedAreas.area: Pure origin, branding and selected value
reviewedAreas.conclusion: Strict exact data descriptors reject coercion/getters; shared creation origin captures world/base revision and four scene fields without granting a catalog brand. Each readonly directory enforces canonical source identity and pins matching origin. First-audio, first-reference and saved-behavior catalogs retain separate WeakMap authority. Only a listed declared track ID can replace an existing String token; no resource-ID inference, name matching, new parameter, author relationship, playback or write authority is introduced.

reviewedAreas.area: Parent ownership and two independent helpers
reviewedAreas.conclusion: References and audio are injected independently and keep separate local directory/selection state. Both receive explicit strict-boolean capability plus session, catalog, script, binding, instance, backend/language, owner/read epochs, origin and raw fragment. Effective changes call the same guarded parent applyChosenString; reading, selections, no-op and failures never invalidate review. Pending responses check generation, current owner, unchanged original source, selected controls and fresh directory identity before proposing or applying.

reviewedAreas.area: Whole-source budget and unfinished sibling behavior
reviewedAreas.conclusion: When an exact reviewed source remains approved, common onUse rebuilds the proposed complete manifest through createContent and the existing scalar/UTF-8/byte limits before touching form state; it then checks approval and ownership again. This also protects unchanged valid sibling fragments. In an unreviewed form it intentionally applies only the valid selected fragment, leaving unfinished siblings untouched for final review.

Runtime build.getAudioTracks checks the live independent sceneAudioDirectory capability before forwarding to the existing readonly inspectSceneAudioDirectory service. Build injects the same optional function; first creation does not borrow saved behavior source authority. The existing service reads a coherent saved world snapshot, resolves the selected scene and single audio relationship, validates the source and declaration, and returns no write or playback capability.

reviewedAreas.area: Native core absence and empty directory fallback
reviewedAreas.conclusion: A ready audio declaration requires the existing native/WASM audio validator. Without native initialization that ready directory fails while an empty/null directory still captures successfully and ordinary manual String JSON remains usable. Unsupported optional capability hides only the helper and does not disable ordinary first behavior review.

The helper compares origin plus normalized directory status, world/scene, manifest identity/path/sourceRevision and ordered track identity/resource/role. The authenticated service sourceRevision hashes the complete saved source, so actual volume/loop/cue edits change freshness. This boundary does not claim to authenticate raw content forged by a trusted host under an unchanged hash and does not expand the UI to control audio declaration values.

results.name: Both actual helpers mount, load and retain independent selections without changing review
One helper effective fill revokes the other pending owner content; explicit retry preserves both values
audio uses common aggregate budget guard and retains a valid sibling and save approval
references uses common aggregate budget guard and retains a valid sibling and save approval
A separate process without native initialization rejects ready audio but retains empty and manual text fallback

verification.countingNote: Five independent direct-process probes supplement the existing named tests; they are not added to the formal full-suite or new-UI test counts.

remainingLimits: This review does not replace actual browser rendering, native audio playback or final complete application checks.
No author schema, persisted document, runtime version, backend adapter, release version or old proof was changed by this review.
